verdict.rationale: Missive's own docs describe shared accounts that several people work out of together: accounts can be shared with teams, conversations are assigned "while maintaining visibility", and team spaces and chat sit alongside the inbox. Community users independently pick Missive specifically for team collaboration in shared threads. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how conversation state (read/archived/closed) is synchronized across all members of a shared account.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state

citations.quote: Have multiple people work out of the same inbox, without stepping on each other’s toes.
Share accounts with teams, individuals, or keep them private. Configure who sees what.
Manage email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox.
Assign conversations to a team or specific person, while maintaining visibility. And jump in, if needed.
See what’s going on, know who’s doing what, and collaborate behind the scenes — without changing your workflow.
I love Streak for singleplayer but prefer Missive or Front for collaboration.
